title: Cretaceous and Tertiary stratigraphy map of the Hollow Creek quadrangle, western Aiken County, South Carolina
citation: Nystrom, P.G., Jr., 1993, Cretaceous and Tertiary stratigraphy map of the Hollow Creek quadrangle, western Aiken County, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-73, map scale 1:24,000.
notes:
Single OCR'd map sheet; map face garbled in OCR. All map symbols read from legend boxes on a page image (OCR garbled 'at', 'th', 'Je', 'ums'). OCR 'burrows | to 2 cm' read as 1 (inferred, unclear in OCR). The text names no numbered drill holes; only the Huber Corporation Paragon test hole is mentioned. SCGS hole labels on the map face (2-1xx, 2-2xx, 2-3xx) were not recorded. Shearer (1917) reference is Georgia-only and not recorded. SUBSURFACE: Qat terrace surface 15 to 30 ft above the Savannah River flood plain; kaolin bed about 20 ft thick at the top of the Upper Cretaceous (no elevation printed).
Single OCR'd map sheet; map face garbled in OCR. All map symbols read from legend boxes on a page image (OCR garbled 'at', 'th', 'Je', 'ums'). OCR 'burrows | to 2 cm' read as 1 (inferred, unclear in OCR). The text names no numbered drill holes; only the Huber Corporation Paragon test hole is mentioned. SCGS drill-hole labels read from the map face on page images (no logs printed; the explanation's 2-106 is the legend sample, the map-face 2-106 is a drawn hole). Labels 2-112 and 2-104 each appear twice on the map face and are recorded as printed; one symbol is labelled SCWRC C-2. Exposure marks (x, Float) carry no labels and were not recorded. Shearer (1917) reference is Georgia-only and not recorded. SUBSURFACE: Qat terrace surface 15 to 30 ft above the Savannah River flood plain; kaolin bed about 20 ft thick at the top of the Upper Cretaceous (no elevation printed).
